schoolSupport.fund: Africa Special Needs Education Support Fund
schoolSupport.heading: Support Special Needs Education Across Africa
schoolSupport.intro: Help identify and support verified special-needs schools across all 54 African countries through the eight approved African regions.
schoolSupport.delivery: The Africa Special Needs Education Support Fund is delivered jointly by NESA-Africa and EduAid-Africa under Santos Creations Educational Foundation. Fundraising and supporter mobilisation are coordinated through Friends of EduAid-Africa and the Africa Education Enablers Network.
schoolSupport.nominate: Nominate a Special-Needs School in Africa
schoolSupport.support: Support a Special-Needs School in Africa
schoolSupport.notice: Nomination begins a verification and needs-assessment process. It does not automatically qualify a school for publication, voting, funding or intervention.
schoolSupport.independence: Donations and sponsorship do not influence NESA-Africa award recognition. School support and award judging remain separate.
schoolSupport.approvalPending: School profiles will appear only after verification and explicit publication approval are confirmed.
schoolSupport.channelsRequired: CONTENT REQUIRED — authorised EduAid-Africa school-support links and publication approvals.
